Source: @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.6868ee8c357f4b73]{Sabbat} Guide, @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.rules-reference-st.JournalEntry.yEPxZHRgMGIQ2JJQ]{Derangements}

Something in your past affected you deeply - it may be the sight of a shovel or the feeling of cold water around your body - but you have an instinctual trigger that causes you to frenzy.

Trigger/Effect: If this trigger affects you, you must test as if for Rötschreck. This Phobia frenzy, if entered, does not cause any lasting Negative Traits.
